body.en:
Question B-002-004-007.

Why the correct answer is right: If a scheduled net is about to begin where you are already talking, courtesy is to move your contact to a different frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Increase your power output to ensure that all net participants can hear you": Increasing power to compete with the net would worsen interference.
- sourceIndex 2: "Transmit as long as possible on the frequency so that no other stations may use it": Transmitting as long as possible to hold the frequency is intentionally obstructive.
- sourceIndex 3: "Turn off your radio": Turning off the radio is not required; simply move if you can do so courteously.
